project.name: osgi/domains/config
project.description: The config domain: the flat bootstrap configuration vocabulary the OSGi world reasons with. config-port carries BootstrapConfig — the Pulumi-free record of derived Stage-A settings (paths, hosts, endpoints, timeouts) plus the pure NFS-automount path rewriting. The derivation FROM the Pulumi-backed Rke2labConfig stays host (BootstrapConfig.from touches com.pulumi); the record itself is the shared frontier value both worlds carry.
